LOW_VISIBILITY.template: Unable to validate repetition due to poor landmark visibility.

TRACKING_GAP.template: Tracking was lost during this repetition, so it could not be validated.

VIDEO_ENDED.template: The video ended before this repetition finished, so it could not be validated.

INVALID_START.template: The video started mid-movement, so the starting position could not be validated.

SQUAT_DEPTH.template: Insufficient squat depth (minimum knee angle {min_angle:.0f}°, target ≤ {target:.0f}°).

SQUAT_HIP_ABOVE_KNEE.template: Hips did not drop to knee level (required by the strict preset).

SQUAT_NO_STAND.template: Incomplete standing extension before the next movement.

SQUAT_START_NOT_STANDING.template: Repetition did not start from a full standing position.

SQUAT_TORSO.template: Significant torso movement detected (peak inclination {lean:.0f}° from vertical).

PUSHUP_SHOULDER.template: Shoulders did not travel far enough downward.

PUSHUP_NO_LOCKOUT.template: Incomplete elbow extension at the top.

PUSHUP_START_NOT_EXTENDED.template: Repetition did not start from fully extended arms.

PUSHUP_SAG.template: Significant hip sagging detected ({dev:.0%} of body length below the shoulder–ankle line).

PUSHUP_PIKE.template: Significant hip elevation detected ({dev:.0%} of body length above the shoulder–ankle line).

PULLUP_START_BENT.template: Started with bent elbows (no full dead hang before the pull).

PULLUP_ROM.template: Insufficient upward range of motion (minimum elbow angle {min_angle:.0f}°, shoulder travel {travel:.2f}× arm length).

PULLUP_NO_HANG.template: Did not return to a dead hang.

PULLUP_CLEARANCE_UNVERIFIED.template: Top clearance could not be verified (no bar calibration, or head landmarks not visible at the top).

PULLUP_CLEARANCE_NOT_MET.template: Head did not clear the calibrated bar height at the top.

disclaimer: RepVision AI provides estimated movement feedback from 2D pose estimation. It is not a medical assessment, injury-risk diagnosis, or guarantee of exercise safety or technique quality. Accuracy depends on camera placement, lighting, clothing and the pose model.
